summary: Frontend E2E of 4 new Tracking sub-features (Speed & Distance, Route Playback, Geofences/Sites, Site Activity, Timesheets) — all pass. Logged in as manager@haulcheck.co.uk, UK region units (mi/mph) applied correctly, John Smith stats render (Distance 142.6 mi, 7 points), playback play button animates counter 1/7 -> 6/7 in 2s and orange playhead circle appears on the map, add-site flow (click Add -> hint appears -> click map -> name/radius form -> Save) creates 'Test Yard' and shows 2 violet circles, delete removes it, London Depot & 'John Smith arrived at / left London Depot' events render in Site activity, Timesheets tab shows 4 rows (filter to John Smith -> 2 rows), Export CSV triggered a real download 'haulcheck-timesheet-2026-08-04.csv'.

issues: Seed shifts show Top/Avg speed 0 mph and Hours 0h (start==end timestamps), likely due to glitch-speed filtering + same-second seed data. Distance renders correctly (91.0 mi / 2.7 mi). Not a UI defect — seed data limitation; consider spreading start/end times in seed for realistic display.

critical_code_review_comments: Tracking.js MapView useEffect for onMapClick has stale closure risk — if onMapClick prop identity changes (it does when addSite toggles), listener re-attaches correctly. OK.
exportCsv builds CSV client-side without escaping commas/newlines in driver_name/vehicle_reg — driver names with commas would break rows. Low risk but worth quoting all fields.
Playback interval 350ms fixed — no rate slider (nice-to-have).
